subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should accepted non-transient gateway disconnects keep the current recook-first fallback model with a fresh session, or should this PR pause until reattach-first recovery is designed?
rationale: The code fix prevents same-session transcript collision, but the remaining two-run behavior can still duplicate model/tool side effects and message delivery, which is an owner-level UX and compatibility choice.

options.title: Land focused fix now
options.body: Accept the timeout-style fresh-session fallback boundary for this rare disconnect path, update the agent CLI docs, and track reattach-first behavior separately.

options.title: Fold in reattach-first
options.body: Pause this PR and require it to wait for or implement the broader recovery design from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200.

options.title: Reject local recook fallback
options.body: Rework the behavior toward no-local-result or wait-only semantics if any duplicate model/tool execution is unacceptable after gateway acceptance.

recommendation.title: Land focused fix now
recommendation.body: Accept the timeout-style fresh-session fallback boundary for this rare disconnect path, update the agent CLI docs, and track reattach-first behavior separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent gateway CLI history and docs ownership signals make steipete the strongest available decision owner for this CLI fallback boundary.
